title: Nursing-home related companies in the influence screens (checked)
question: Do the management, staffing and landlord companies behind San Francisco nursing homes lobby the City, give, or sit near a commission?
finding: 29 related companies and owner chains named by San Francisco nursing homes were searched in the lobbying, donor, commissioner, requested-payment and gift screens: 3 found: Bmo Bank, N.A. (lobbyists: What clients pay lobbyists; lobbyists: The firms that are paid to lobby; lobbyists: Organizations the City pays that pay lobbyists); Front Porch (lobbyists: What clients pay lobbyists); Sequoia Living (statemoney: City payees in State politics). Nothing else: no management, staffing or landlord company of a for-profit San Francisco home lobbies, gives, or is declared by a commissioner in the published rows.
how: Party names from nursing_money (related payments in San Francisco, federal owner chains, chain names) looked up by normalised name in lobbyists, sidedoors, officials, fastlane, chains, boardvotes, votes, leaks, statemoney and gifts.
limits: Only published rows are searched; State lobbying and federal contributions are outside these files. Companies often lobby through a trade association, which this name test cannot see.

rows.seen: lobbyists: What clients pay lobbyists; lobbyists: The firms that are paid to lobby; lobbyists: Organizations the City pays that pay lobbyists
statemoney: City payees in State politics

sources.t: California Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI), Long-Term Care Facility Integrated Disclosure and Medi-Cal Cost Report, complete data sets 2019 and 2022 (audited), 2023 to 2025 (as submitted)
Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), nursing-home provider data, October 2026 (provider information, ownership, penalties, health citations)
San Francisco Ethics Commission: Lobbyist Activity Directory - lobbyists’ monthly reports of contacts, payments from clients, contributions and expenses (DataSF)
San Francisco Controller: Vendor Payments (Vouchers), totals by payee, department and fiscal year (DataSF)
